text:
Maya: Quick heads-up: shifting the order for today's all-hands so leadership Q&A goes first (14:05) — aiming to make it easier for remote folks. Also noticed the main room camera dropped HDMI lock twice in setup. AV Team, what's our fallback?

Carlos: moving Q&A up works for me. can we still run captions after the demos? accessibility team asked for that.

Eve: saw the HDMI flakiness during preflight. PTZ seems to re-negotiate and sleep intermittently. log snippet: 
```
[PTZ] HDMI handshake timeout
[Kernel] nouveau: hdmi: EDID read failed
```

AV Team: options: a) switch to SDI bridge + redundant PTZ, b) hot-plug presenter laptop and run OBS composite, c) last-resort Meet-only stream (no recording). Preferences?

Jordan: prefer keep the public stream. try SDI bridge first, but have the laptop-OBS scene ready. enable captions in whichever path we choose.

AV Team: SDI bridge power is flaky. we'll hot-plug laptop and start OBS scene "allhands-laptop-fallback" now. enabling OBS recording to NAS simultaneously.

MediaBot: Recording created: allhands_preflight_1787724444.mkv (1.1GB)

Priya: quick infra ask: if we go laptop-OBS fallback, we should disable hardware acceleration in browser on the laptop (chrome --disable-gpu) to avoid GPU contention with OBS.

Carlos: captions question: can we ingest Meet captions into OBS? If not, activate OBS captions plugin.

AV Team: OBS captions plugin installed. starting captions (en-US). RTMP to rtmp://backup.redwood/ah-1787724444 active.

OpsBot: Network watch: transient jitter spike on conference VLAN at 15:12 UTC. packet loss peaked at 1.2%. Monitoring.

Maya: logistics Q: who is moderating remote questions in Slack? we need someone to triage for leadership.

Jordan: I'll moderate with Priya. Maya will handle the on-site queue.

Eve: note: camera lock restored after reseating HDMI and disabling PTZ auto-sleep. still keeping laptop-OBS hot backup.

MediaBot: Stream status: primary encoder disconnected at 15:14:03 UTC. Backup OBS encoder live at 15:14:41 UTC.

Carlos: launching the live poll after demos as planned 1: please remind folks to upvote questions in the thread.

Maya: leadership, FYI a pricing clarification slide for Dedicated capacity was added last-minute. will you cover it during Q&A?

Jordan: yes, short segment in Q&A. Priya will take deeper pricing follow-ups offline.

AV Team: OBS recording active and uploading to NAS with fallback label: "ah-1787724444-fallback-obs.mp4"

OpsBot: conference VLAN jitter back to baseline at 15:19 UTC. no end-user impact detected.

MediaBot: Captions active (confidence: 0.91). transcripts will be available after the event.

Maya: All set. Q&A goes live in 5. big thanks for the quick pivot. if anything else pops up ping @AV Team.

Carlos: Posting reminder in #all-hands to drop questions and vote.

Jordan: closing thread. will open follow-up if action items arise. thanks team :raised_hands:
